lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, forming a semi-regular grid with spacing between centroids increasing slightly towards the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical spot columns, creating a geometric lattice where the high-luminance centroids serve as the primary nodes of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge located on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-value pixels on the dorsal side and deep shadowing on the ventral side, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.
